payload.rationale: Hard-gate failures cannot be repaired within Patch Generator constraints without editing locked canonical sections and/or changing existing /id values. Specifically: (1) the id_integrity failures for deliverable IDs require changing existing /plan_package/milestones/*/deliverables/*/id values, which is disallowed; (2) the missing-risk reference issues and stage-model inconsistencies originate in /plan_package/architecture/options (locked), requiring edits there to remove/normalize risks lists and to reconcile stage naming/order; (3) decision_log evidence pointer shape and tool_policy Review/Intake write-permission blockers are patchable, but fixing only those will not clear the remaining hard-gate id_integrity violations tied to locked sections and prohibited /id edits. Reroute is required to an owner allowed to modify architecture/options and/or adjust ID policy.
